svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.27.3.8 Flashing Installation
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.27 CLADDING
Flashing Installation

g.text: Upper element laps the lower 25 mm or
more: flashing need not be installed
CLAUSES REFERRED TO IN THE PANEL
Sentence (2): (a) where the upper cladding elements overlap the lower cladding elements by not less than 25 mm (1″), (b) where (i) the cladding
above and below the joint is installed outboard of a drained and vented air space (see Clause 9.27.2.2.(1)(a)), and (ii) the horizontal detail is
constructed so as to minimize the ingress of precipitation into the air space, or (c) at horizontal construction joints in stucco, where (i) the
joint is finished with an expansion-contraction strip, and (ii) the cladding is installed outboard of a drained and vented air space (see Clause
Sentence (4): (a) extends not less than 50 mm (1 15/16″) upward inboard of the sheathing membrane or sheathing installed in lieu of the sheathing
membrane (see Article 9.27.3.4.), (b) has a slope of not less than 6% toward the exterior after the expected shrinkage of the building frame, (c)
terminates at each end with an end-dam (i) with a height in millimetres not less than 25 mm (1″) or 1/10 the value of the 1-in-5 driving rain wind
pressure in Pa, and (ii) at the height defined in Subclause (c)(i), extending to the face of the adjacent cladding, (d) laps not less than 10 mm
(⅜″) vertically over the building element below, and (e) terminates in a drip offset not less than 5 mm (3/16″) outward from the outer face of the

svg.text: WHAT THE CODE REQUIRES
Except as provided in Sentence (2), flashing is
installed at
(a) every horizontal junction between cladding elements, (b)
every horizontal offset in the cladding, and (c) every
horizontal line where the cladding substrates change and
where (i) the substrates differ sufficiently for stresses to
be concentrated along that line, or (ii) the installation of
the cladding on the lower substrate may compromise the
drainage of moisture from behind the cladding above. (See
Flashing need not be installed as described in Sentence
(a) to (c): see the box below the drawings.
Flashing is installed over exterior wall openings where
the vertical distance from the bottom of the eave to the
top of the trim is more than one-quarter of the
horizontal overhang of the eave.
Flashing described in Sentences (1) and (3)
(a) to (e): see the box below the drawings. (See Note
Where the sills of windows and doors installed in
exterior walls are not self-flashing, flashing is
installed between the underside of the window or door
and the wall construction below.
Schematic sections, not to scale. Not drawn: Clauses (2)(b) and (2)(c), and the end-dam depth, (4)(c)(ii).
Source: BCBC 2024, Division B, Article 9.27.3.8. (page 9-258)
